lines.en: I creep along the silt.
I push myself forward, step by step.

lines.zh: 我的身体软软的，走得很慢。
lines.en: My body is soft, and my pace slow.
I keep to the cavern floor, looking for food.

lines.zh: 我拱开一层泥，底下是石头。
lines.en: I root up a layer of silt; stone beneath.
I shake the mud off my back.
I work along the trench inch by inch.
I squeeze past a sunken stone.

lines.zh: 我身上沾满了泥，看不清颜色。
lines.en: Mud covers me; my color is hidden.

lines.zh: 我慢慢朝有味道的地方去。
lines.en: I move slowly toward the smell.

lines.zh: 我边走边在泥里拱吃的。
lines.en: I root through the mud as I go.
I float up a little.
I sink back and keep crawling.
I root along like a plough.

lines.zh: 我停在洞底的一个洼地。
lines.en: I stop in a hollow on the cavern floor.
I push into deeper silt.
I lie on the silt without moving.

lines.zh: 我身上有几根小管在动。
lines.en: A few small tubes on me are moving.
I slowly spread myself flat.
I roll over in the silt.
I spit out a mouthful of cloudy water.
I keep to the floor, very quiet.
I am listening to the water's direction.
I lift one end and set it down.
All my movements are slow.

lines.zh: 我在等泥里有什么东西动。
lines.en: I wait for something in the silt to move.
Another layer of silt settles on me.
Down here nothing chases me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把自己拱高一点。
lines.en: I root myself up a little.

lines.zh: 我在这块泥里待了很久。
lines.en: I have been in this silt a long time.
I lift my head and look at you from the mud.
You stand at the water's edge. I am below.

lines.zh: 我从泥里朝你的影子爬。
lines.en: I crawl through the mud toward your shadow.

lines.zh: 我身上全是泥，你不介意吧。
lines.en: I am covered in mud. You do not mind.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边的泥上停下。
lines.en: I stop in the silt by your feet.

lines.zh: 我抬起来一点，又沉下去。
lines.en: I rise a little and sink back.
I have no teeth and do not bite.

lines.zh: 我朝你脚边的泥拱了拱。
lines.en: I root at the silt by your feet.

lines.zh: 我转身，露出背上的管子。
lines.en: I turn and show the tubes on my back.
I sink back into the mud.
I ball myself up.
I push into the silt.

lines.zh: 一撞，我翻过去又翻回来。
lines.en: One bump and I roll over and back.
A layer of mud is gone from me.
I loosen up and spread across the mud.
I spit out a mouthful of water.
I sink to the very bottom.
I press to the silt and hold.

lines.zh: 我从泥底慢慢浮回水面。
lines.en: I drift back up from the bottom of the mud.
I move toward the cavern wall.
I smell silt. I am coming.
I come to your hand.
I take it in with the mud.
I push it out and chew slowly.
I want one more mouthful to root out.
I nudge your hand for more.
I press it into the silt with my back.
I slowly take it in.
I look up for more.
Having eaten, I sink back into the silt.
You touch me; I curl up.

lines.zh: 我歪倒在水里，慢慢翻正。
lines.en: I tip over in the water and slowly right myself.

lines.zh: 我背上的泥掉了一小片。
lines.en: A patch of mud falls off my back.
I slide past the edge of your boot.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，泥水浑了。
lines.en: We collide; the water clouds.
I sink to the bottom and rise again.
I do not struggle at all.

lines.zh: 我把身体摊平，钻进泥里。
lines.en: I flatten and push into the silt.
I show a little again.

lines.zh: 我慢慢爬回原来的位置。
lines.en: I crawl slowly back to my spot.
Another is turning over in the silt.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，泥把我们粘住。
lines.en: We press together; the mud sticks us.
I nudge its back.
It pushes mud my way.
We roll in the silt together.
It is a little rounder than I am.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一处，谁也没动。
lines.en: We press together and neither of us moves.
The water pushes us together.
It burrows away first.
We each sink into the silt.

lines.zh: 我把它和泥一起吞下去。
lines.en: I take it in with the mud.
I push it back out to look.
I push it aside with my body.
It is too hard to take in.
I bury it in the silt beneath me.
I slowly push it into the silt.
It rolls around in my mouth.
I leave it on the silt.
I have no hands. I can only root.
I stop paying it any attention.

lines.zh: 你的靴子陷进了我的泥。
lines.en: Your boot has sunk into my mud.

lines.zh: 我把身子转朝你的方向。
lines.en: I turn my body toward you.
I move toward your feet.

lines.zh: 我身上竖起了几根管子。
lines.en: A few tubes on me rise.

lines.zh: 我只是想知道你是什么。
lines.en: I only want to know what you are.
I stop by your feet.
I root at your boot.
I have noted your scent.
I sink back into the silt.
I am right here and not leaving.
I follow your feet along the silt.
You take a step; I shift a little.
I root about by your feet.
This has always been my pace.
You step down; I give way.
I float up a little.
Only when you lower yourself do I dare move up.
Wherever you walk, the mud follows.
You step back; I follow.
I stay slow.
I bump your foot. Very light.
I bump the top of your boot with my head.
I smear mud on your boot.
I push your foot with my body.
This much force will not hurt you.
I sink down again.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，压到你的脚。
lines.en: I roll over onto your foot.
I pull back into the silt.
I do not bite. I cannot.
I rise again.
I rise out of the silt.
I roll over in the mud first.
My body slowly unfolds.
The water is deep here. Good.
I move toward the cavern floor.
I root up a small heap of silt.
Weeds are tangled in the mud on my back.
I stop and feel the water.
I root along looking for anything to eat.

lines.zh: 我把身子一点点埋进泥。
lines.en: I bury myself in the mud bit by bit.
The water heats; I burrow into the silt.
I land in the silt and sink in.

lines.zh: 水本该是我的地方，可我呛住了。
lines.en: The water is my home, yet I choke.

lines.zh: 爆炸把泥和水一起掀开。
lines.en: The blast throws mud and water.
An arrow buries in my body.
That light makes the water hot.

lines.zh: 没有泥可以拱了，我越来越瘦。
lines.en: Nothing left to root through; I thin out.
Lightning reaches through the water.
The water is gone; I fall through nothing.
